note: Test-id ledger for GF-2 T2 (the fold-epoch guard compares the kernel overlay, the Q1 freeze rule, the reformat of the 11 corpora to format 2, the T1 review fixes and the guard CLI fixtures reading the live epoch table; owner rulings 2026-10-15), built against base b55925506 (the rebased GF-2 T1 head). Ids are relative to the engine collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` (--isolate on BOTH sides) from the engine directory, the WHOLE package, DATABASE_URL empty. T2 adds 61 tests and rewrites 2 titles (6229 -> 6290 collected): 26 in test/fold-epoch-guard.test.ts, 20 in test/fold-epoch-guard-cli.test.ts, and 15 from the T1 review and the T2 review fixes in src/testkit/golden-format.test.ts and golden-overlay.test.ts (the two rewritten titles are the 'format 1 today' test and the '(the default)' test, both made format-agnostic). The reformat commit changes no test id: the corpora are data. Scope: the matrix and scripts roots are not collected because T2 changes no file under tools/matrix or scripts; apps/web is untouched except by reading the reformatted corpora (outcome-readers, timeline, public-player-matches, player-matches, forfeit-vocabulary-scan re-run green, 134 passed 41 skipped for want of Postgres).
